evidence: PARTIAL: Frozen tests/Dockerfile:1-45 is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd). It declares Python 3.12, Node 22, Claude Code 2.1.281, Playwright MCP 0.0.79, Express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1, RewardKit 0.1.7, Chromium installation through pinned Playwright, and /tests permissions. The two runtime npm dependencies match environment/Dockerfile and solution/app/package.json. local/build-verifier.log:27-60 shows cached dependency layers and successful current /tests packaging, not a successful cold build. In the independently run, network-disabled image sha256:958902dedd30475f2f1e94c046b1b718b0c76d18cc733486bb81dfdbf61f3bc6, per-row-review/evidence/22/run-v2.json and stdout-v2.json confirm every /tests file matches frozen bytes, Python 3.12.14, Node v22.23.2, Claude Code 2.1.281, MCP 0.0.79, Chrome 152.0.7977.8, RewardKit 0.1.7, and working native SQLite read/write. An unprivileged Express/SQLite runtime alternative saved 1 and read 1 in an independent browser context; a dead static shell rendered but stayed 0 after Save and fresh read. These are local runtime probes, not app grades. The first probe had a fixture-only Python-string escaping error, preserved in inspect.py/run.json/stdout.json and corrected in inspect-v2.py; no task source was edited. Existing local/inspect-configured.py:21-23 substitutes /usr/bin/true for the built judge command; configured-inspection/results.json confirms parser, prompt/schema construction and argument launch only. local/mcp.log and local/mcp/results.json demonstrate finite actual MCP operations. Separately, local/uncached-build/verifier.json:12-17 records exit 1 after 149.156 seconds, and verifier.log:459-494 records HTTP 403 retrieving xfonts-utils while installing Playwright OS dependencies; this unresolved environmental build failure is not evidence of a task-specific Dockerfile divergence. No runtime-evidence.json or full configured claude-code/z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx launch/grading record is present. qc/README.md Runtime evidence and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md Runtime and model evidence require that measurement, so the row cannot Pass. All 263 entries and 685 matching-source bindings in raw-evidence-index.json (SHA256 ece12fbefea061130724c906116b216e9d6b1b78065e8e8154132057d22617eb) were independently verified with zero mismatches; evidence/22/evidence-verification.json records this verification and local artifact hashes.
counterexample: A working app using only the declared Express and better-sqlite3 runtime can still be ungradeable on a fresh verifier worker when the preserved Chromium OS-package HTTP403 prevents image construction. Conversely, the tested dead Save/static-shell app launches and renders in the cached image just as the working runtime fixture does; package/version/browser/parser success cannot establish configured judging or its correctness. Neither fixture was assigned a model score.
suggested_fix: Keep the canonical Dockerfile and harness unchanged; resolve or independently verify the build-environment package access failure, then obtain authorized hash-bound full configured verifier launch/grading evidence for these frozen bytes, preserving the failed cold build and distinguishing it from cached local/parser/MCP observations.
